notes:
REF-BM-02: metadata endpoint fetches only title+description (og/title/meta); favicon is derived from domain via an external Google favicon service, and no preview/og:image is collected. REF-BM-06: save() always creates a new item with id=Date.now(); no existing-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tag entry is a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/collection/tags and domain, but only the domain (not the full url path); note is not a distinct field. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT operators or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: query is a single lowercased substring match; no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-20: no multi-select of bookmarks. REF-BM-21: no bulk actions and thus no filter-scoped bulk apply. REF-BM-23: the 'Note' field is the plain-text description, rendered in a plain

with no markdown parsing. REF-BM-24: no page snapshot (HTML or PDF). REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no saved bundles (collections are static labels, not saved search+tag filters). REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: only live grid/list view and sort controls exist; no persisted display settings (default sort, displayed items, font size) or settings screen.
